title: Tethered EEG Recordings in Syngap1 rats
description: Six-hour tethered EEG recordings from wildtype and Syngap+/Δ-GAP heterozygous rats (male, 12-16 weeks old), collected between zeitgeber times 3 and 9 under a 12:12 light-dark cycle. Recordings used a head-mounted 32-channel EEG array with accelerometers, sampled at 1 kHz. Most animals have two recording sessions. The data support study of SYNGAP1-related neurodevelopmental pathophysiology.
methods_description: EEG was acquired with an Open Ephys system and a head-mounted 32-channel EEG array probe (NeuroNexus H32-EEG) with accelerometers at a 1 kHz sampling rate. Recordings were 6 hours long, starting at ZT3-9, in freely moving tethered rats.
